name: suganthan-gsc-mcp
description: Ask Claude real questions about your Google Search Console data. 27 SEO analysis tools, local and private.
long_description: A Google Search Console MCP server that answers questions, not API rows: quick win keywords, traffic drops, content decay, cannibalisation, CTR benchmarks, multi site dashboards, and a full image search suite. Free and open source. Runs entirely on your machine: your data goes straight from this computer to Google and nothing passes through anyone else's servers.

access_level.title: Access level
access_level.description: readonly (recommended) or full. Full adds sitemap and URL submission tools.

secrets_file.description: Path to your OAuth client secrets file. Needed until built in Google sign in ships; see the README quick start.
